meaning: In an already identified room, the recipient should take care and deliberate about responding to the identified question; prohibit haste, directly consider the question, take time, or pause/wait under a modal. Optional location phrases refer to that same room.
gate: Require a parsed opening/ending pair plus two licensed whole-chunk extensions each paying at least one owed letter. If empty, do not invoke interior search.
repetition: Finite cost, never veto; payoff guides only; center-out closure requires empty debt.
quality_rubric: Frozen 019 dimensions 0-5, holistic 0-10, actual human preference labels separately preserved.
training_preferences: The ten positively labeled examples are preferences/controls, not held-out evaluation.
lexical_scope: Frozen Brown POS + existing dictionary and morphology, plus explicitly authored finite semantic classes and constructions. No general-English coverage or phrase-attestation claim.
